notes.title: Card Upgrade Hotfix
notes.notes: Fixed an issue where upgrading cards in Eternal Recurrence could expend resources without upgrading the card.

notes.title: Update Notes for Feb 13
notes.notes:
Content
[list]
[*] 6 new cards have been added to Eternal Recurrence - cheap rares/epics and expensive commons to help round out the set.
[*] A new item has been added to the Golden Ichor shop that allows you to save and use a reward from Eternal Recurrence.
[*] A card collection is now available in your collection where you can view all cards that you have seen. If you haven't collected a card, you will only see its name. 
[*] Refreshing berry trades is now guaranteed to give different reagents than the previous refresh.
[/list]
Balance
[list]
[*] Vermin Cabalist's health has been buffed. 
[*] Drop rate from Vermin King has been set to 1/100 of its previous value. Sorry guys - the Savant's Pants were never meant to be that easy to get!
[*] Core Stat talent costs now scale up more slowly.
[*] Core stat values on a few equipment pieces have been nerfed.
[/list]
QoL / Visuals
[list]
[*] A button has been added to the Eternal Recurrence sell interface that automatically adds all cards to the sell pool except for the highest rank cards that you can use for a deck. i..e, for an epic card it will sell all but the two highest rank cards.
[*] Eternal Recurrence will now remember the last deck you used and have it automatically selected on different playthroughs.
[*] Unit and spell cards in Eternal Recurrence now have different colored backgrounds.
[*] Some values in the Bestiary and AFK gains now show abbreviations rather than the full value.
[*] Harvesting a plant now shows a little floating text with the yield, to give you some more endorphins!
[*] Combat text will now tell you if you have an ability equipped that an enemy is immune to.
[/list]
Bugs
[list]
[*] You no longer need 2+ harvests in order to use the "Harvest All" button.
[*] Stat changes now register immediately upon unequipping equipment.
[/list]

notes.title: Patch Notes February 4, 2024
notes.notes:
Features
[list]
[*] The save location of the game file has now changed to incorporate your Steam ID. This should prevent different Steam accounts on the same device from overwriting each other's saves. The game will automatically look for a save in the old location if it doesn't find one in the new location, so you should be able to load the game without issue.
[*] You can now name your character and change their portrait! And there are extra portraits available for beta testers! You can change your name or portrait in the Settings accessible from the Menu.
[/list]
Balance
[list]
[*] The "Ember" ability unintentionally dealt more damage than its counterparts from different classes and has been nerfed.
[*] The "Energy Drain" ability has had its mana cost reduced.
[*] The "Armor Piercer" ability has had its effect changed to double the next instance of damage against the monster it is used on.
[*] The "Gigantic Germ" card has had its Golden Ichor multiplication nerfed.
[*] The class XP bonuses on a few monsters has been switched around so that they are not immune to the damage of a class that gains bonus XP from them.
[*] Class perks now always apply once they have been unlocked, though they will suffer penalties when underleved, similar to other abilities.
[/list]
QoL
[list]
[*] You can now right click a card in Eternal Recurrence to give a close-up view, in addition to being able to click the eye icon.
[*] Tooltip text will now warn you when an ability has its mana cost or effectiveness penalized from being underleveled.
[*] Viewing a card's evolution will also show keywords from the evolution.
[*] Added a "Water All" and "Harvest All" button.
[*] You can now see already purchased premium items.
[*] When a new map location is unlocked, you will now see a notification on the map button. This feature can be turned on or off in the Settings.
[/list]

notes.title: Premium Items Patch
notes.notes:
Bug Fixes: 
[list]
[*] Fixed some poorly optimized code in the save function that was causing the game to slow down while saving, so that periodic autosaves caused the game to freeze every five seconds
[/list]

Content:
[list]
[*] Several new items are now available in the premium store! 
[*] The old code to gain premium currency has been removed. But there's a new one, and it gives even more! Use the code "NUMBERSGOUP" to gain some free Eternal Essence. I'll be removing this before I do the early access release on Steam, so grab it while you can as thanks for playtesting!
[/list]

notes.title: Second Island Patch
notes.notes:
Features
[list]
[*] A number of existing dialogues have been rewritten. You will see a lot of notifications reappearing on the map.
[*] 6 new monsters have been added on a new island with new enemy abilities! Go defeat them to earn new knowledge bonuses, unlock new RP Perks, and craft new equipment with new reagents! Note that in order to access the new island, you will have to revisit old areas, as there is a condition that certain dialogues must have been triggered before you can advance.
[*] The Additional Berry Trader item from the garden has been removed. The additional trade is now available by default.
[/list]

notes.title: Bugfix 12-28-23
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug that would cause Golden Ichor bonuses to not be loaded correctly
[*] Fixed an issue that prevented hovered cards from coming to the foreground in Eternal Recurrence
[*] Fixed an issue that would cause it to be possible to get a poison damage quest
[/list]

notes.title: Card Drag Hotfix
notes.notes: Fixed an issue where players would become unable to play cards.

notes.title: Eternal Recurrence Update
notes.notes: The newest game feature, Eternal Recurrence, is now available! Visit the Skittering Depths to unlock this card-based minigame!

notes.title: On-Death Hotfix
notes.notes: Fixed an issue where enemies with on-death abilities were causing prediction and offline gains to not work properly.

notes.title: Update Notes for Nov 16, 2023
notes.notes:
Fixes:
- The health and mana bars now match at the end.
- Time during this rebirth now updates properly when the game is open.
- The "Currently Equipped" panel now updates when an item is upgraded.
- Fixed an issue where there would be one less talent point available than there should be (curse you, floating-point errors!)

Features:
- There is a new "options" button in the menu. Through it, you can toggle off and on notifications on your tabs when you gain a main LVL, when you unlock a new class ability, and to turn off and on combat logs.
- The combat log option creates a .log file in your save folder showing the simulated combat results when you claim offline gains and use the "predict" button. This isn't going to be a refined feature and is mostly meant for testing if something funky is going on with fighting predictions, and I will probably hide it when Steam's full release rolls around.
- The plant panel now shows the estimated time to the next upgrade.
- An icon on the map will now show your current location.
- Location and enemy names will now be hidden if you have not killed at least one enemy in the previous zone.
- Added a border to class abilities whose color is different based on whether the ability is active, passive, or a class perk.
- Added a link to the Discord in the main menu.

notes.title: Update Notes for 10-28-23
notes.notes:
Fixes:
- Fixed an issue with loading berry trade data when an additional trade slot is purchased.
- Fixed an issue with offline reagent drops when the probability of a drop is over 100%.
- A level 0 hat will no longer be inserted into empty equipment slots.

Balance:
- The formula for berry cost reduction to level a plant has been modified. It will give a smaller reduction when you are less than twice the amount needed for growth, but will give more beyond that point.
- The speed at which berry trade cost scales up has been reduced.

Features:
- The Shrimpocampus plant now gives a one Eternal Essence every five levels per harvest, up to five per harvest.

Reworks:
- Harvests and berry trade refreshes now bank charges, accumulating one every twelve hours, up to a maximum of 3.
- The garden UI has been reworked to be less cramped, and has tooltips describing some mechanics.
- Plants will have their upgrade growth rate drop after 24 hours. There is a 20 hour cooldown on watering them.

notes.title: New Save Format Patch 10-26-23
notes.notes:
Fixes:
- Fixed various typos
- Fixed the Lassetarian plant's fertilizer
- Defeating an enemy now removes all negative status effects from the player.
- The tooltip no longer fails to expand properly to contain its text.

Features:
- The game has switched to a new save format. If no save in the new format is found, the loading screen will give an option to try loading from the old format. All new saves created will be in the new format, even if you loaded from the old format.
- Backup saves will only be created for saves older than three hours, to prevent backups from being accidentally overwritten when creating a new game.
- When failing to load properly, an error message will now appear showing which area of the game failed to load to help with diagnostics.
- When no valid save file is present, there is now an option to attempt to load from the backup.

notes.title: Unguaardly Plant Hotfix
notes.notes: Prevent the Unguaardly plant from breaking the garden.

notes.title: Bottled Time Hotfix
notes.notes: Bottled time accumulation rate is no longer 3000 times its intended speed.

notes.title: Update Notes for Oct 21, 2023
notes.notes:
Fixes:
- The purchase button in the store can no longer be clicked when an item is not selected.
- Text in the log will now start with the scrollbar at the top.
- Reagent drop chance will now display correctly.
- The vermin stone drop rate is no longer 100%, but 10% as it was intended.
- Offline and Predict correctly activate Sporegon's on death ability
- Added description for Fecundity.
- Abilities have had their icons aligned in the selection menu.
- Empty ability slots in the bestiary are no longer an eye-gouging bright white.
- Predict and offline progress now implement minimum respawn time.
- You can no longer equip class perks.

Balance / Reworks:
- Bestial knowledge is now unlocked by entering the second zone. Knowledge gain is always active, with 0.5 knowledge per kill being the baseline. Bestial Knowledge increases this value.
- The scaling for several passive abilities, including bestial knowledge, have had their scaling tweaked. Class Lvl now affects them more.
- Talent TP costs now scale independently. Scaling has been adjusted.
- Class abilities are now permanently unlocked if you have reached the designated class level, but an underleveled penalty is applied when below their unlock level. Certain abilities that have utility outside of their effectiveness will have increased mana cost when underleveled. Class Perks will still require you to reach their level to take effect. I was already tracking your highest class level, so this should apply retroactively! :)

New Features:
- Logging out in the safe zone will cause you log back in at the last zone you visited.
- The travel indicator now shows distance traveled necessary to reach a monster.
- Added quit game button in main menu.
- Added travel button in the Bestiary.
- Added immunities and travel distance in Bestiary.
- Added the Misc tab in Stats, which shows knowledge gain.
- There is now an "enter code" button in the menu, where you can enter the code "920672" for some Eternal Essence!
- The game window will now start as windowed by default and can be resized.
- Backup saves will be created on the first autosave of each play session. If your game crashes, I'd recommend saving the backup files "Backup[1-3].save" somewhere else, then trying to change their name to "Autosave.save" to reload them. This is a quick solution to alleviate the risk of crashes while I try to work through a more deliberate system.
